educationalGoal: In this introductory course, students will focus on developing basic skills of com munication in modern Japanese reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice: Students will learn the Japanese writing system (hiragana and katakana) and fundamental grammatical structures, and practice simple conversational skills such as introductions, describing and asking about places, and talking about daily activities. This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on t his site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.

activityGoals.body: Read and write the Japanese writing system (hiragana, katakana, and kanji) .
For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them correctly.
Learn basic conversational skills such as giving a self-introduction and describing things.
